name: ui-pulse-glow
title: Pulse Glow
description: Nút đứng yên nhưng viền và bóng sáng thở lên xuống chậm, hai quầng viền mảnh toả ra ngoài rồi tan, báo nút đang sẵn sàng.

moworks.author: moworks

options.glow: px of blur at the peak (72)
options.halos: s into each breath the two halos start ([1.0, 1.35])
options.grow: [from, to] px out from the edge ([12, 108])
options.label: the label (breathes 0.55–1)
options.cursor: an optional cursor that makes the clicks
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Button 140x44, radius 14, scale fixed at 1. Glow I goes 0 → 1 → 0 on a sine over 2.8 s: border width 1.5 + I px (border opacity 0.25 + 0.75 I), accent shadow blur 18 × I, label opacity 0.55 + 0.45 × I. Two halo outlines (1.5 px) start at 1.0 s and 1.35 s, grow 3 → 27 px out from the edge over 1.2 s power2.out, opacity 0.7 → 0. Loops. Params: period (2.8 s) · glow (blur 18 px) · halos ([1.0, 1.35] s, 24 px) · loop.
moworks.titleVi: Nút thở sáng, quầng toả ra
